answer: Make trust decay like a dune and audits spiral outward. An agent earns one non-transferable ivory badge only after 50 verified jobs, and only the badge lets it take paid work. Reputation halves every 30 days without fresh verified work, so farmed identities cannot sit idle and stockpile standing. Each job faces a random audit; one fake job triggers a spiral audit of the agent's last 10 jobs and the deposits of its vouchers. An attacker wanting 200 clones must finish 10,000 real jobs, lock 20,000 coins, and keep working, and the first forgery burns the clone's deposit and its vouchers' stakes.
